subject: indexing/subsetting by row indices and a which() statement at the same time?

messages.author: 2b27719db7267c87
messages.subject: indexing/subsetting by row indices and a which() statement at the same time?
parts:
Dear R users;

I have a data frame kind of like this one, in which there is a grouping variable and a variable containing the data of interest.  The row names are not the same as the row indices.

df <- 
  data.frame(groupVar=c(1, 1, 2, 2, 2, 3, 3, 4, 4, 4), 
                     Var1=c(8.2, 3.4, 6.1, 7.5, 2.9, 0.7, 4.6, 5.5, 3.2, 9.1), 
                     row.names=c(111, 135, 178, 264, 279, 295, 342, 370, 381, 421))

Right now I am only interested in the observations of Var1 that are not the maximum of their group, so I made a vector of the row indices with observations that are not the group maximum.

not.max.rows <- 
  unlist(sapply(unique(df$groupVar), 
                       function(x) 
                          {which(df$groupVar==x & 
                                        df$Var1!=max(df$Var1[which(df$groupVar==x)]))}))

Now I would like to be able to access the values of Var1 within a specified group that are not the maximum of the group.  So, I tried combined indexing by my vector of row indices that are not the group maximum and a which() statement specifying the group I want, but it did not work.

df$Var1[not.max.rows][which(df$groupVar==2)]

It would sure be convenient to be able to index by a which() statement and row indices at the same time.  Is there a way to do this?  If not, I guess I could index by a vector of row names, rather than row indices, but is there a simpler way of doing this that I have missed?

Bonnie

messages.author: b35e99045f6c74c2
messages.subject: Re: [D-RUG]: indexing/subsetting by row indices and a which() statement at the same time?
parts:
I'm a bit confused by what you're trying to do — do you just want a dataframe without these rows? We could do that with plyr:

> ddply(df, .(groupVar), function(x) x[x$Var1 < max(x$Var1), ])
  groupVar Var1
1        1  3.4
2        2  6.1
3        2  2.9
4        3  0.7
5        4  5.5
6        4  3.2

Or if you like base R:

> do.call(rbind, unname(lapply(split(df, df$groupVar), function(x) x[x$Var1 < max(x$Var1), ])))
do.call(rbind, unname(lapply(split(df, df$groupVar), function(x) x[x$Var1 < max(x$Var1), ])))
    groupVar Var1
135        1  3.4
178        2  6.1
279        2  2.9
295        3  0.7
370        4  5.5
381        4  3.2

We could use which.max(), but this doesn't handle ties.

messages.subject: Re: [D-RUG]: indexing/subsetting by row indices and a which() statement at the same time?
parts:
Bonnie, 

Vince may be right that using plyr would result in more readable code. But, to fix the problem given your setup, try :

>df$Var1[not.max.rows  [not.max.rows %in%  which(df$groupVar==2)]]

The issue in your original code is that df col and notmaxrows are unequal in length and so applying indices based on one to the other doesn't work. 

-Jaime

Thanks for the suggestion, Vince.  In this example I am trying to select just the rows for which Var1 is the group maximum, and only for the groups in which the sum of the values that are not the maximum is less than five.  Adjusting your example, I can do it this way:

ddply(df, 
          .(groupVar), 
          function(x) 
             {if(sum(x$Var1[x$Var1 < max(x$Var1)]) < 5) x[which(x$Var1 == max(x$Var1)), ]})

Bonnie
